pictures.name: ZSC1-Night-Escape
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A dark winter forest at night under a cold moon, mist between bare trees. Far away on a narrow path, a lone tall figure in a dark blue robe and blue turban, a bow on his shoulder, walks away from the viewer, small against the vast trees. Deep blue shadows, one thread of moonlight. Grief and courage. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.

pictures.name: ZSC6-Today-Grandfather
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting in the same style, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern scene painted like an old master. No readable text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos. A modern kitchen in the morning: an eighty-year-old Sikh grandfather in a neat navy turban, white beard, cardigan, a walking stick against his chair, a hospital letter folded on the table beside his cup of tea, smiles warmly at someone off-frame. Sunlight through the window, deep blue shadows. Courage and warmth.
